name: plucked-text
title: Plucked Text
description: A bold one-line headline resting on a taut string stretched between two dots. Drag the line down or sweep the cursor across it and the letters ride the vibration until it settles flat again.
use: A short, bold hero headline should invite play, and a string metaphor suits the brand.
avoid: It handles one short line only and the stage captures touches, so pages cannot scroll over it on mobile.
a11y: The full text is exposed to screen readers and reduced motion swaps ringing for a short ease, but there is no keyboard way to pluck it. (keyboard: no, labels: good, reduced motion: respected)
looks: A wide white sans headline centred on black, with a thin grey rule running under the baseline and a small dot at each end. A muted caption sits below the headline.
behaves: Dragging the string bends it into a V under the pointer while the letters dip and tilt along it; releasing starts a damped ringing that eases flat. Sweeping the cursor across the line strums it without a click.
customise: Pass the line through text, adjust how fast it rings with tension, and turn sweep-to-strum off with strum. The hairline colour and the clamp-based type scale come from classes.
weight: light: A single frame loop over a few wave modes that stops as soon as the string rests.
